items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Edith Turner and the Jazz Giants... INTERVIEWEE: That's right. Her and her husband. She played piano and he played drums...

ctx.x: Up there. They had the family orchestra.
Edith Turner and the Jazz Giants, or whatever it was called.

That's right. Her and her husband. She played piano and he played drums, and Floyd and them was young. I think they had one sister that danced... And they had a pretty good act on the Orpheum Circuit at one time.
